ENGLISH: The Low Germans have for a long time been treated as secondary citizens and slaves by the Sorbian upper class. While they surely deserve it the bohemian aristocracy has always had a distaste for it, thusly our only alternative is to end the barbaric practice and try to integrate the now free slaves into civilized society.

The Swabian states have always held a special place within the Empire. They did not join their German brothers during the wars of religion, staying loyal to the Emperor and the Holy See. They are a loyal catholic people, and integrating them into a unified Empire should be relatively easy.
The Rhenish have evaded our rule with the help of the scheming Burgundians. After our recent ascenion however they can resist imperial authority no longer.
